note: AFL draft picks that changed hands, 2007 on: each pick's path between franchises (hops, oldest first, each naming the trade it moved in) and the player it was used on. Rebuilt once from MFL's transaction and draft records; 'grade' is GUESS where the draft slot could not be pinned to one trade path. trades['<timestamp>:<franchise>-<franchise>'].sides lists what each franchise gave up; a pick token that maps to no traced pick (an untraded-pick record gap) keeps its raw MFL token.
